display.purpose: The hero headline only. Peaks at 64px.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, bounded to 54-64ch. 60ch is the house measure.

label.purpose: Navigation, buttons, form labels, table cells.

script.purpose: Section kickers only. Decorative, aria-hidden, never load-bearing.

shadows.name: shadow-cta
shadows.purpose: The terracotta primary button at rest. Tinted in its own colour, not grey.

shadows.name: shadow-cta-hover
shadows.purpose: Paired with translateY(-2px). Shadow and translate move together or it reads as a jump.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Homepage price cards only. The documented exception to flat-by-default.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system. Exponential ease-out, no bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Header solidify, nav underline sweep, menu open.

motion.name: sheen-sweep
motion.purpose: The primary CTA's diagonal light band. Neutralised under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Blur-in text reveal. Only ever applied after motion is confirmed allowed, so content is never gated on it.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: The WhatsApp action. The only filled terracotta button on any page, and the only thing that lifts.
components.html: Chat with us on WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 1rem 26px; background: #a8503d; color: #fff; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(168 80 61 / 30%); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.28) 50%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-120%); transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgb(168 80 61 / 40%); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::after { transform: translateX(120%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Form submit. Olive, deliberately quieter than the WhatsApp CTA beside it.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; background: #3d5a3a; color: #fafffb; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d5a3a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sage-washed field with a visible label. Placeholder-as-label is forbidden.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c2117; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem; font: inherit; color: #1c2117; background: color-mix(in srgb, #b9cba0 12%, transparent); border: 1px solid #e4decd; border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #3d5a3a; outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d5a3a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #9f1239; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A 2px currentColor underline grows from the left on hover and focus, and stays put for the active route.
components.html: HomePricing
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #1c2117; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding-block: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; inset-block-end: 0; height: 2px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.ds-is-active { color: #3d5a3a; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav-link.ds-is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Open Row
components.description: The system's replacement for the card. Name and price share a baseline inside a 60ch measure; a hairline separates, nothing encloses.
components.html:
Website Rescue & Rebuild

R2,500 – R8,000

We take it over, fix what is worth keeping and rebuild the rest. Priced on how much work it actually needs.
components.css: .ds-row { padding-block: 2rem; border-block-start: 1px solid #e4decd; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; max-width: 60ch; } .ds-row-name { margin: 0; font-family: 'Zilla Slab', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.6vw, 1.35rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; color: #3d5a3a; } .ds-row-price { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: #1c2117; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-body { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; max-width: 60ch; line-height: 1.65; color: #6c6957; }

components.name: Sticky WhatsApp Bar
components.description: Mobile-only, fixed bottom, z-index 200. Plain markup with a real href — nothing that could fail or defer. Yields while an in-page CTA is visible; fails open.
components.css: .ds-sticky { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #fafffb 92%, transparent); } .ds-sticky-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 3.25rem; background: #a8503d; color: #fff; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(168 80 61 / 30%); } .ds-sticky-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
Everything is stated in the open and nothing is boxed away. This system reads like a well-kept account book rather than a brochure: entries divided by hairlines, prices sitting on the same baseline as the thing they belong to, olive as the ink, parchment as the ruling, and terracotta carrying the line you are meant to act on. The layout is the argument — a visitor who scans it should conclude that this business has nothing to hide before reading a word about honesty.

It is a warm system, but warmth comes from hue and voice, never from softness of structure. Zilla Slab's slab serifs give headings the weight of a printed heading rather than a marketing headline. Work Sans carries body copy at a full 1.65 line-height because the audience is scanning on a phone, on data, and legibility outranks personality. Alex Brush appears at most once per page, as a script kicker, and never sets anything a visitor must read to understand the page.
keyCharacteristics: Open rows and hairlines, not cards — content divided by whitespace and 1px parchment rules
One loud thing per screen: the filled terracotta WhatsApp CTA. Terracotta appears elsewhere as accent and detail, but never as a second filled button competing for the same tap
Prices always in the body font, never a display or script face
Every text colour measured against Paper and documented; the muted grey exists twice so the readable one is the only one used for text
Mobile-first at ~85% of the audience: 44px+ targets, Save-Data respected, reduced-motion honoured everywhere

rules.name: The Terracotta Family Rule
rules.body: DESIGN.md is the single source of truth for colour roles; this entry is a pointer, not a copy. See "The Terracotta Family Rule" under Named Rules in DESIGN.md section 2. Summary: three approved tokens (terracotta-soft, terracotta, terracotta-dark), each used only in its documented role. Decorative use is allowed; a second filled terracotta button and terracotta text on Parchment are not.

rules.name: The Semantic Separation Rule
rules.body: DESIGN.md is the single source of truth for colour roles; this entry is a pointer, not a copy. See "The Semantic Separation Rule" under Named Rules in DESIGN.md section 2. Summary: errors, warnings and destructive actions use erica, never the brand accent.

rules.name: The Olive Focus Rule
rules.body: DESIGN.md is the single source of truth for colour roles; this entry is a pointer, not a copy. See "The Olive Focus Rule" under Named Rules in DESIGN.md section 2. Summary: the keyboard focus ring is olive and is not an accent alias.

rules.name: The Two Greys Rule
rules.body: The muted grey exists twice on purpose. --bark-grey (3.62:1) fails AA and is for hairlines and decoration; --bark-deep (5.47:1) is for anything a visitor has to read. Never set text in --bark-grey.

rules.name: The Green Near-White Rule
rules.body: The page background is Paper, tinted toward the brand's own green. Never substitute a warm-tinted near-white — cream, sand, bone, linen, parchment-as-background. The warm-neutral band is the saturated AI default and this brand is explicitly defined against it.

rules.name: The Legible Price Rule
rules.body: Prices are set in the body font, never a display or script face, and never wrap. Hand-lettered or ornamental numerals are ambiguous at a glance, which contradicts 'honesty is the aesthetic'.

rules.name: The Silent Script Rule
rules.body: Alex Brush never carries information. If removing the script line would cost the reader anything, it was doing a job it is not allowed to do — move the words into the heading.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: One h1 per page, and it says what the page is in a plain sentence. Headings are sentences, not labels.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a 1px --parchment rule before reaching for a border box, and for whitespace before reaching for a hairline. Heavy card, border and shadow treatment is rejected: it reads as software, and this business is a person.

rules.name: The Nested-Box Prohibition
rules.body: A bordered thing inside a bordered thing is always wrong here. If content needs grouping inside an already-ruled row, group it with spacing.

dos: Do reference semantic aliases (--color-text-muted, --color-accent), not raw hues — but note the aliases resolve to whichever token is correct for the job, so 'use a semantic alias' is the rule, not 'everything points at a -deep'.
Do state prices plainly and early, in the body font, on the same baseline as what they buy. Never behind a 'contact us' wall.
Do divide content with whitespace and 1px --parchment hairlines.
Do bound body copy to 54-64ch and headings to 16-20ch.
Do give every tap target 44px, and every inline link at least 24x24 (WCAG 2.5.8).
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion on every animation and Save-Data on heavy media. Both are non-negotiable.
Do make reveals enhance an already-visible page. Content is never gated on a class-triggered transition — a crawler, a PDF capture or a hidden tab must still see the section.
Do measure any new colour against Paper before assigning it to text, and write the ratio into tokens.css.
donts: Don't use terracotta outside the three approved tokens, or for errors, warnings and destructive actions — those are Erica. And don't put terracotta text on Parchment; that is what terracotta-dark is for.
Don't reach for corporate/agency gloss — no 'we're a team of experts', no stock-photo polish, no invented statistics, testimonials or case studies.

Don't reach for the generic SaaS-startup look — no gradient-heavy hero-metric templates, no dashboard chrome, no cold/sterile minimalism. Depth, cards and shadows read as 'software', which is the opposite of this brand.
Don't substitute the cream/sand AI-warm default for Paper. The warm near-white is the reflex this palette is defined against.
Don't fall into proteas-everywhere literalism. Fynbos is textural, not decorative; the identity is a sunbird.
Don't box a box. Nested cards, bordered things inside bordered things, and side-stripe accent borders are all prohibited.
Don't set a price, a heading, or anything load-bearing in Alex Brush.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section. One script kicker on one section is voice; a kicker on every section is scaffolding.
Don't add a 'Most popular' badge, a ranking, a fabricated metric or a mocked-up search position. If the data does not exist, the pixel does not either.
Don't ship an interior page as a single narrow column of text with no compositional move. If it looks like a document rather than a page, it is not finished.
